job: Draw an organisation's first-letter mark on a server or in an email, with no DOM.
purpose: Pure functions from fire/js/initial.js: initialMark(name) returns the dot-matrix SVG as a string in currentColor, initialRows(name) returns seven strings of five 0 and 1 cells for a mail client that draws no SVG, and initialTone(name) returns the tone the name maps to. The same name always gives the same glyph and tone. In a page, data-fd-initial draws the same mark.
useWhen: A server-rendered page, a PDF or an email needs the mark an organisation without a logo shows in the app.
The tone of a name is needed in code, for example to colour a row in a list you build yourself.

avoidWhen.when: The page is in a browser and the markup is yours to write.
A person's initials in a box under 28px.

states.name: labelled
states.how: initialMark(name, { label: true }) adds role="img" and an aria-label

states.name: other first character
states.how: a character that is not A-Z or 0-9 draws a diamond
